highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.4 adds GTK 4 views and expands native platform coverage while improving stream and loading reliability.
highlights_body: Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets join the package set. Android view reattachment, tvOS simulator linking, reflection-disabled AOT, and Windows CPU-only startup receive fixes, alongside refreshed native dependencies.

breaking.title: Update platform-specific .NET targets
breaking.body: Platform libraries move to .NET 9 and .NET 10 target sets. Update platform-specific consumers to a compatible target and workload; this does not remove the existing net462 and .NET Standard compatibility targets for core libraries. .NET Framework 4.8 is added and recommended for desktop applications.

breaking.title: Do not use the generated Blazor _Imports type as a component
breaking.body: The generated SkiaSharp.Views.Blazor._Imports type no longer derives from ComponentBase or implements its component interfaces. Remove code that instantiates or treats that generated imports type as a Blazor component.

bullets.detail: Adds SkiaSharp.Views.Gtk4 with SKDrawingArea and GTK/Skia geometry and color conversions using GirCore bindings. A follow-up fix prevents Cairo snapshot assertions during repeated redraws.
Adds linux-bionic x64 and arm64 assets for SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp without fontconfig dependencies. Tizen gains x64 and arm64 assets alongside its existing 32-bit targets.

SKManagedStream duplicates and forks use a cached, ref-counted SKData snapshot. The original remains readable, multiple duplicates are allowed, and disposing the parent can close the .NET stream without invalidating the duplicates. Non-seekable streams return null for duplicate and fork requests.

bullets.lead: Native loading on Linux and Windows
bullets.detail: Fixes Linux ARM64 fontconfig loading and LoongArch native linkage. Windows CPU-only rendering can load without Direct3D 12 components, and ANGLE statically links its C runtime to avoid requiring the VC++ Redistributable.

bullets.lead: Android reattachment and tvOS simulator linking
bullets.detail: MAUI Android SKGLView redraws after returning to a tab or page at the same size. tvOS packages and native references distinguish simulator frameworks from device frameworks, preventing simulator link failures.
SKBlender initializes blend modes without reflection, avoiding TypeInitializationException when IlcDisableReflection=true.
Updates libpng to 1.6.58, libwebp to 1.6.0, Brotli to 1.2.0, and libexpat to 2.7.3. Native SkiaSharp builds also enable Spectre mitigation flags on Windows and Linux.

preview_summaries.v3.119.3-preview.1.1: Fixed Linux ARM64 font loading and reflection-disabled AOT, refreshed native dependencies, and enabled Spectre mitigation flags.
preview_summaries.v3.119.4-preview.1.1: Added GTK 4 views, Linux Bionic assets, and 64-bit Tizen support. Introduced independent managed-stream snapshots and fixed Android view reattachment, tvOS simulator linking, and Windows startup without Direct3D 12.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp adds Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets and separates tvOS simulator assets from device frameworks. Its platform target sets move with the .NET 9/10 update; the 8.3.1.5 package revision is not a native engine upgrade.
